comment: Curated exploitability statements for RoboDR releases. scripts/vex.py turns them into OpenVEX (signed release asset robodr-<version>.openvex.json) and CSAF 2.0 VEX (.github/workflows/vuln-scan.yml). Every advisory that cargo-deny / osv-scanner reports against a published release (vuln-scan.yml) needs a statement here: not_affected with a justification and impact, affected with an action, fixed, or under_investigation. docs/RELEASE.md, 'Vulnerability monitoring and VEX'.

statements.impact_statement: Informational 'unmaintained' advisory: ansi_term has no known vulnerability. It is linked only into robodr-pulsard (Pulsar bpf-common -> nut) and only formats ANSI colour codes of log output. Tracked in deny.toml; review by 2027-04-17 or on the next Pulsar bump.
